signatureLegend: one character per cheap direction (directions with cheap: true, in order): + with, - against, 0 none, ~ mixed, . fewer than 8 climbs
strategiesLegend: per strategy, per rule: for k in ks, [runs, runs raising the rule, mean Δbits given a rise]
climbsLegend: per rule, per direction (in the order of directions): [moves, moves raising the rule, moves lowering it, mean Δbits given a rise, mean price (fee + surcharge, bits) of the raising moves]
repeatsLegend: per rule, per direction: the direction repeated 8 times from every state, [runs, runs raising the rule, mean Δbits given a rise, mean price (fee + surcharge, bits) of the 8 moves of a raising run]
opportunityLegend: per rule A, per direction (in order): one character per rule C (in the order of rules): the number of fractions in [0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4] that C's opportunity cost reaches, as a share of A's gain, in at least half of A's rising runs of 8 repeats (C's cost: its best bits one move from the start, or staying, less its bits at the run's end); " " the same family, "." fewer than 8 rising runs
exclusionLegend: per rule A: one character per rule B (in the order of rules): "1" when, from A's sampled states with A ≥ 8 bits (up to 12), a greedy climb of B of 3 cheap moves keeping A within 1 bit leaves B within 1 bit of its floor (median over law draws) in at least half; "0" otherwise; "." uninformative (fewer than 4 such states, or B does not rise above floor + 1 climbing freely from law draws); " " the same family
